Where we deliver:

Here's our return and refund policy:
Cancellations:
You can cancel an order for a full refund within three days of purchase, provided it hasn't shipped yet.
Returns:
We do not accept returns based on taste preferences or change of heart once an order has been safely and successfully delivered. Due to state regulations, we cannot accept the return of alcohol purchased by a customer in error.
EU customers: Orders placed via the EU Flaviar website (https://eu.flaviar.com/) can be returned within 14 days from the delivery date according to EU regulations. You are responsible for the costs of postage and packaging if you choose to return a product within this period.
Damaged or incorrect items:
If you receive damaged or incorrect goods, please notify us within 7 days of the delivery date with your order number, an explanation of the issue, and photos of the package and its contents. We'll arrange an exchange, or if a replacement isn't available, you'll be issued a refund once the item is returned in the condition it was received.
Non-returnable items:
Personalized items (e.g., engraved bottles), all items from presales, special releases, and items of seasonal relevance are non-returnable and non-refundable unless stated otherwise.
Undelivered orders:
